title: 第30章 二星卡徒
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
“小奇回来了。”

    从万卡阁回到家，推门而入的瞬间，熟悉的声音伴着饭菜的香气扑面而来。

    林奇的目光立刻锁定在厨房忙碌的身影上。

    只见瑞廉叔正系着林峰那条洗得发白的围裙，手里握着菜刀在菜板上有条不紊地切着蘑菇。

    “呃，瑞廉叔？”

    林奇快步走上前，语气里满是疑惑：“你怎么在这儿做饭？我爹呢？”

    瑞廉一边往锅里切着蘑菇，一边说道：

    “你爹说要冲击五星御卡师，怕分心误了事儿，特意让我过来替他看店，顺便给你做口热乎的。”

    “哦？老爹终于要突破了！”

    林奇眼睛瞬间亮了。

    这个消息对他来说，简直比赚了一笔大钱还让人高兴。

    林峰卡在御卡师四星已经十年了，这么长时间，哪怕是条咸鱼也该蹦跶一下了吧。

    小时候他还以为是林峰当年做佣兵时留下了内伤，这才让境界一直停滞不前。

    直到长大后，他渐渐摸清了自己老爹的性子后才恍然大悟。

    这老家伙哪里是受伤和天赋差，他纯纯就是好吃懒做！

    之前林峰做佣兵时刀尖舔血，每次出任务都要打生打死的，就算不主动修炼，源力也能在战斗中提升上去。

    可自从他转行开了这家店后，林奇凭着灵活的经商头脑把生意打理得井井有条，林峰身上的担子一下子卸了个干净。

    每天不是躺在摇椅上喝茶，就是去街坊家下棋，小日子过得比退休老人还惬意。

    而且他还美其名曰，说自己这实力在石铁城够用了，反正也突破不了御卡大师，四星和五星都一样。

    人就是这样，只有被压力和危险裹挟才能进步。一旦躺平，就像生了根似的，再也不想起来了。

    “现在看来，是我的制卡天赋让老爹重新感受到了压力，想把自己境界提升上去，好帮我解决一些不必要的麻烦。”
content_en:
"Xiao Qi is back."

After returning home from Wanka Pavilion, the moment I pushed the door open, a familiar voice hit my face along with the aroma of food.

Lin Qi's eyes immediately locked on the busy figure in the kitchen.

I saw Uncle Rui Lian wearing Lin Feng's washed white apron, holding a kitchen knife in his hand and methodically cutting mushrooms on the cutting board.

"Uh, Uncle Ruilian?"

Lin Qi walked forward quickly, his tone full of confusion: "Why are you cooking here? Where is my father?"

Ruilian said while cutting mushrooms into the pot:

"Your father said that he wanted to attack the five-star card master. He was afraid that he would be distracted and miss the task, so he asked me to come over and look after the store for him, and give you a warm mouthful on the way."

"Oh? Dad is finally making a breakthrough!"

Lin Qi's eyes lit up instantly.

For him, this news was even more satisfying than making a lot of money.

Lin Feng has been stuck at the fourth star of the Card Master for ten years. After such a long time, even a salted fish should take a break.

When he was a child, he thought that Lin Feng had suffered internal injuries when he was a mercenary, which was why his realm had been stagnant.

It wasn't until he grew up and gradually figured out his father's temper that he suddenly realized it.

This old guy is not injured and has poor talent, he is just too lazy to do anything!

In the past, when Lin Feng was a mercenary, the tip of his sword licked blood, and he had to fight to the death every time he went on a mission. Even if he didn't take the initiative to practice, his source of power could be improved in battle.

But since he changed careers and opened this store, Lin Qi used his flexible business acumen to manage the business in an orderly manner, and Lin Feng's burden was suddenly lifted.

Every day he would either lie on a rocking chair and drink tea, or go to a neighbor's house to play chess. His life was more comfortable than a retired man's life.

Moreover, he also said that his strength was enough for Shi Tiecheng, and he couldn't break through the Yuka Master anyway. Four-star and five-star were the same.

This is how people are, they can only make progress when they are under pressure and danger.Once I lay down, it was like taking root and I never wanted to get up again.

"Now it seems that my card-making talent has made dad feel the pressure again, and he wants to improve his level so that he can help me solve some unnecessary troubles."
